people.name: Abel-meholah
people.line: A town in Israel, home of Elisha.

people.name: Ahilud
people.line: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon

people.name: Baana
people.line: One of Solomon's twelve district governors.

translations.web: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
